card.name: Linking words after "at greater risk"
card.fires_on: The small word right after "risk" in phrases like "at greater risk of/for", where a harm such as hyponatremia or toxicity comes next. Also on linking words like "may" or "serious" just before a named adverse outcome.

modes.label: After "risk"
modes.description: The word "of" or "for" following "greater risk" in warnings about at-risk groups such as the elderly.
modes.example: Elderly patients may be at greater risk<< of>> developing hyponatrem

modes.label: Other lead-ins to an adverse outcome
modes.description: A linking word such as "at", "may" or "serious" just before the named harm.
modes.example: Thiazides have been shown to increase the urinary excretion of magnesium; this<< may>> result in hypomagnesemia.

card.plain: It marks the point in a warning where an at-risk group is about to be linked to a specific harm, like low sodium.
